# AUTO-GENERATED — tools/gen_sand_soldiers_maa.py
# create_maa_regiment.size = (界面规模×100)÷stack；预览/实际士兵 ≈ 界面规模×100
# 生成兵种在玩家 var:ucm_sand_maa_pick 上分支，避免复制 flag 到目标后匹配失败

ucm_sand_compute_regiment_size_effect = {
  if = {
    limit = {
      has_variable = ucm_sand_staged_scale
      has_variable = ucm_sand_staged_stack
      var:ucm_sand_staged_scale >= 1
      var:ucm_sand_staged_stack >= 1
    }
    set_variable = {
      name = ucm_sand_spawn_actual_men
      value = {
        value = var:ucm_sand_staged_scale
        multiply = var:ucm_sand_staged_stack
      }
    }
  }
}

ucm_sand_spawn_from_player_pick_effect = {
  if = {
    limit = {
      exists = scope:ucm_sand_spawn_tgt
      exists = scope:ucm_sand_player
      scope:ucm_sand_player = { has_variable = ucm_sand_maa_pick }
      scope:ucm_sand_spawn_tgt = {
        has_variable = ucm_sand_staged_scale
        var:ucm_sand_staged_scale >= 1
      }
    }
    if = {
      limit = {
        scope:ucm_sand_player = { var:ucm_sand_maa_pick = flag:light_footmen }
      }
      scope:ucm_sand_spawn_tgt = {
        ucm_sand_spawn_maa_at_staged_scale_effect = { TYPE = light_footmen }
      }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = {
        scope:ucm_sand_player = { var:ucm_sand_maa_pick = flag:armored_footmen }
      }

      }
    }
    else_if = {
